decisions.reason: A newly launched two-component resin injection unit fits the firm's core injection business and needs more than a year to recover development costs.
A second resin injection variant likely serves a different capacity or application segment for construction customers, and dropping it after one year would be premature.
Automatic airless spray guns are core accessories that drive recurring spare-part sales with industrial coating lines.
A manual airless gun is a staple high-volume product for the firm's spray equipment customers and is cheap to keep in the range.
Air-assisted airless guns complement the gun portfolio for finer finishes on vehicles and machinery, a key customer segment.
The data logger supports the digitalization and quality documentation trend in coating, though as a less core electronic product it carries slightly higher discontinuation risk.
